WITH geol AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    AVG(geolocation_lat) AS lat,
    AVG(geolocation_lng) AS lng
  FROM geolocation
  GROUP BY geolocation_zip_code_prefix
),
order_seller AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    o.order_id,
    oi.seller_id,
    gc.lat AS cust_lat,
    gc.lng AS cust_lng,
    gs.lat AS seller_lat,
    gs.lng AS seller_lng
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN geol gc ON gc.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
  JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
  JOIN geol gs ON gs.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = s.seller_zip_code_prefix
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT
  seller_id,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      6371.0 * 2 * ASIN(
        SQRT(
          POWER(SIN(RADIANS(cust_lat - seller_lat) / 2), 2)
          + COS(RADIANS(seller_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(cust_lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(cust_lng - seller_lng) / 2), 2)
        )
      )
    ), 2
  ) AS avg_distance_km,
  COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders_count
FROM order_seller
GROUP BY seller_id
ORDER BY delivered_orders_count DESC, avg_distance_km DESC;
